title: Bauchmann N Scale Dow Canada Caustic 41' Chemical Dome Tank Car CGTX 14003 Green
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Freight Cars
descriptionText: The Bauchamnn N Scale Dow Canada Caustic 41' Chemical Dome Tank Car CGTX 14003 in green is a model train tank car designed for N scale layouts. Made of plastic and diecast materials, this tank car features a realistic design with a chemical dome theme, perfect for transportation enthusiasts. With an analog control system and a DC power type, this tank car is a detailed addition to any model railroad layout, showcasing the precision and quality craftsmanship of Canadian manufacturing.
